title: Karaoke Studio v2.0.8
changelog: Compact TV Stage Header: reduced size of HOST IP badge, brand logo, microphone icon, and soundwave animation bars for a clean visual layout
Restored Stage Controller & Settings: fixed deck visibility toggle button and on-screen controller keypad with integrated TV FX Settings drawer
Auto-Hide & Auto-Close Stage Controller: stage controller automatically closes and hides whenever TV Settings or modal drawers are open
Smooth Playback Performance: eliminated fill-rate intensive blur filters in favor of hardware-accelerated text-stroke and single-pass shadow, eliminating TV playback lag and stutter
Live Settings & SoundFont Synchronization: real-time 0ms sync between Mobile Remote and TV Stage with active soundfont switching and user state preservation
